programmes.t: RiffTrax: Terror In The Wax Museum
programmes.d: Mike, Kevin, and Bill all hope to one day be enshrined in Madame Tussauds. Until then, they'll be settling for this riff. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programmes.t: RiffTrax Live: "Manos" the Hands of Fate
programmes.d: This is a completely new riff of “Manos” The Hands of Fate, the Texas-fertilizer-salesman-directed classic made famous by Mystery Science Theater 3000.

programmes.t: RiffTrax Live: The Giant Spider Invasion
programmes.d: Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for RiffTrax Live: Giant Spider Invasion! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

When an atomic bomb test triggers the arrival of invaders from another planet, some hack director combined the dumbest plots of a dozen b-movies into a single film! This feature contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

RiffTrax takes on one of the most loved Z-grade action films of the early 90s: Samurai Cop. The cop they call Samurai takes himself and his fabulous hair (really, it is an amazing thing to behold) to Los Angeles from a faraway land they call San Diego.
From the stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 comes the comedic genius known as Rifftrax!

programmes.t: RiffTrax Short: Your Chance To Live
programmes.d: What happens when a public television studio realizes that it has to spend $2,000 of government grant money before Wednesday in order to qualify for full funding for the next fiscal year? You get Your Chance to Live: Technological Failures!
Shyness—for years it has prevented boys from becoming men and girls from landing men.
Can Trash fight off a Bronx full of gangs, death squads, and Red Sox fans? This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K

programmes.t: Rifftrax Shorts: Why Doesn't Cathy Eat Breakfast?
programmes.d: From the stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 comes the comedic genius known as Rifftrax!
These beliefs are bad, and not just “the Tim Burton Planet of the Apes is the best version” bad. They're seriously bad. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

If you took a D&D adventure written by an 8th grader and turned it into a movie, you'd wind up with Hawk the Slayer. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

The beloved arcade beat 'em up is now a movie! Kind of! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programmes.t: RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa
programmes.d: Just in time for the holidays, RiffTrax presents our take on A Visit to Santa, a Christmas short of unknown origin that most probably was the result of Santa's short-lived collaboration with the producing team of Screwtape and Wormwood.

programmes.t: RiffTrax Shorts: How to be a Friend
programmes.d: This DIY video shows you how to build your very own friendship, step-by-step! Start with courtesy, kindness, and honesty, then add buddies Bridget and Mary Jo to laugh along with! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.
